title: ArticlePublishInput
description: Input for POST app://self/article-publish. Performs the draft → published state transition. The public request carries only the article id plus an optional timestamp override; status is derived server-side as "published" before calling the command.

errorMessage.type: Article id must be a number.
errorMessage.minimum: Article id must be at least 1.

publishedAt.description: Optional override. When omitted or null, ArticlePublish supplies the current UTC timestamp before invoking ArticleCommandInterface::publish().

errorMessage.type: Published date must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time.
errorMessage.format: Published date must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time.
